17:31 Local Time, 13:31 GMT, 19:01 IST: Hello and welcome, everyone, to live coverage of the 2nd T20I between Afghanistan and Zimbabwe! The hosts come into this clash holding all the momentum after lifting the Tri-Series trophy and comfortably taking the series opener. Skipper Ibrahim Zadran will be eager to keep their dominant run going, while star man Rashid Khan continues to weave his magic with both bat and ball. As for Zimbabwe, they're in desperate need of a turnaround, struggling for consistency across all three departments, particularly with their top order failing to set a base. Can the visitors bounce back, or will Afghanistan seal another clinical win? Stick around as we head pitchside for the toss and team updates!
Zimbabwe have won the toss and have opted to field
Shahidullah Kamal to Tafadzwa Tsiga, 1 run, flat good length and into the pitch outside off, Tafadzwa Tsiga gets forward to force it wide of long-off

Shahidullah Kamal to Sikandar Raza, SIX, the 100-run stand is up. It's too late though this hit. It's a good length delivery around off, Sikandar Raza sits deep in his crease, pulls over the deep square leg fence
Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai, right-arm medium, comes into the attack

Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai to Tafadzwa Tsiga, 1 run, very full outside off, Tafadzwa Tsiga gets forward to drive to sweeper cover. That should be the game provided Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai doesn't bowl any extras
Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai to Sikandar Raza, wide, and he bowls a wide miles outside off. Almost didn't land on the cutstrip

Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai to Sikandar Raza, SIX, full and in the slot and it has gone over the roof at long-on. Sikandar Raza sinks on his back knee, lofts and he has really hit that well. Change of ball as well as that one has gone out of the ground. A souvenir for someone outside the stadium
A replacement ball now.

Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai to Sikandar Raza, 1 run, Sikandar Raza take a bow! His 2nd T20I 100. First against a Full Member. Met with a hug by Tafadzwa Tsiga. No extravagant celebrations understandably. Just raises the bat to the dugout. Gets there by driving the low full-toss to deep extra-cover
Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai to Tafadzwa Tsiga, 1 run, very full outside off, Tafadzwa Tsiga gets forward to drive to long-on
Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai to Sikandar Raza, no run, low full-toss outside off, Sikandar Raza looks to slog to leg and misses

Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai to Sikandar Raza, SIX, Afghanistan seal the series but Sikandar Raza has landed another ball on the roof. If I remember correctly, this is the 3rd one of the night for him. Full outside off, he sinks low and swings it miles over deep backward square-leg. Lands on the roof but Afghanistan win by 19 runs

22:05 Local Time, 18:05 GMT, 23:35 IST: Valiant effort by Sikandar Raza but he can't prevent his side from losing. Rashid Khan comes and embraces him in a warm hug. They are good friends and were seen having a long chat before the match today. Zimbabwe will only be wondering how they allowed Afghanistan to post 221 from 5/4. That's where the game was lost. A new opening combo came out today as Bennett and Kaia started well. Then Raza came at 3 and was there till the end. But 221 proved to be 19 too many. Had someone helped Raza out a bit more with the bat, Zimbabwe might well have pulled this off. Ryan Burl falling cheaply hurt Zimbabwe for the left-hander could've scored in quick time. Raza though kept fighting till the end and deservedly reached his 2nd T20I ton. Tafadzwa Tsiga gave him good company and he looked impressive with the bat on debut. Rashid and the skiddy Abdullah shone for the hosts. Stay tuned for the post-match stuff....
STAT: 8th successive T20I series that Afghanistan have won against Zimbabwe, who are yet to win one.
Rashid Khan took his 200th T20I wicket tonight - the first man to do so. Watch how he got there.

Ibrahim 2/2: [On rotating the squad and giving opportunities ahead of the 2028 World Cup] Yeah, definitely. If you look at today’s game, we have rested two guys, Fazalhaq Farooqi and Noor Ahmad. They bowled really well in the last game, and we have given chance to Abdullah Ahmadzai and Fareed Malik. This is the opportunity that we should give to them until we’re going to go for the '28 World Cup. So every single game, every series is very important for us to win a game, to win a series. Along with that, opportunity is also important to give to the players that they feel themselves that we’re going to do something for the country.

The series is done and dusted and Zimbabwe's wait for a maiden T20I series win against Afghanistan continues. We still have a game to go in the series and that's on the 1st of November.
